honest_c3: C1 — No actual training_args.bin inspection. This audit reads source + train_avg_harvest_result.json:ckpt_top_keys but does not torch.load(best.pt)['args'] to extract production weight values. DEFAULT_WEIGHTS in source may have been overridden at production launch via HexadLoss(weights=...). All weight figures are SOURCE DEFAULTS, not measured in-training values.

C2 — DEFAULT_WEIGHTS may not be production weights. HexadLoss constructor accepts weights override. The 0.0/0.4/0.15/0.15/0.2/0.1 figures are source defaults; production 350M paradigm v11 G3 run could have used different ratios. Verify by torch.load(best.pt)['args'].

C3 — PhaseManager phase boundaries may have been different. train_clm.py declares 0.10/0.25/0.70; older train_v14.py archaeology may show different splits. Step-to-phase mapping for the production checkpoint is implicit, not verified via log.

C4 — Corpus content not inspected. data/corpus_v11_multilingual.txt file not opened. The '0% chat' claim is based on grep on train_clm.py source code (structural handling), NOT on actual corpus content. Naturally-occurring dialogue (fiction, forum scrapes) in the flat text corpus is possible and would constitute a weak chat signal.
C5 — MoE aux loss share not quantified. moe_aux_weight default 0.01 enters total_loss when MoE is enabled. Absolute magnitude relative to L_D is unmeasured. Out of scope for $0 mac.

C6 — 57% effective CE coverage figure depends on PhaseManager defaults. Arithmetic assumes 0.10/0.25/0.70. If args.phi_only_ratio > 0 was set, the 57% shrinks. Should be read as order-of-magnitude (~half budget), not precise.

C7 — CLM-3 §5.1 weight prescription (0.45/0.30/0.10/0.10/0.05) is heuristic, not validated. Defensible starting point but no empirical basis. CLM-3 build MUST run weight-grid ablation before committing $1k / 30 days.

verdict_one_line: paradigm v11 G3 training objective = 40% next-token CE on flat multilingual + 60% Hexad sensorimotor/memory/ethics on consciousness signal in P3 (1.0 CE in P2, 0 gradient in P0/P1); next-token weight alpha NON-ZERO (~57% effective budget) but CE corpus contains 0% chat-formatted dialogue, making chat-incapability root cause 'CE applied to non-chat corpus' rather than 'no CE at all'; CLM-3 BG-BM spec needs explicit delta*L_CE_general term + F-CLM-3-5 weight-ablation falsifier.
